title: Snaky in 21 Maker moves

abstractEnglish: We prove that Maker can achieve the Snaky hexomino within 21 actual Maker moves against arbitrary legal Breaker play on the initially empty infinite square board. The same bound holds on a $`17\times17`$ square; in fact, Maker can confine its claims to a fixed 251-cell board.
